base: black-and-white editorial vintage documentary photograph, desaturated, high contrast, grainy film texture. SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio. Dense morning haze; the ENTIRE UPPER THIRD of the image is bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the top edge for clean compositing. Subjects dark, low in the frame. No text, no words, no logos, no gradients, no added color, no stock photo look, no modern machinery.

images.scene: A rooftop terrace of rough bare concrete (a Brazilian 'laje') with a low unfinished brick parapet, camera placed very low, almost resting on the concrete floor. In the lower part of the frame, small and seen from behind, a boy in a simple t-shirt stands as a dark silhouette, leaning slightly backward, both hands gripping a taut kite line that pulls hard against a strong wind. The thin dark line runs perfectly straight and tight, diagonally upward from his hands, to a small dark handmade paper kite in the MIDDLE of the frame, bowed and straining against the wind, its long ribbon tail streaming sideways. Beyond the parapet, rooftops of a hillside neighborhood dissolve into the pale haze. The kite must read clearly as a dark shape against the bright sky.
